source_instruction: what deodorants do you have that are alcohol free and very long lasting?
query: Ugh, my neighbor’s tabby cat keeps sneaking onto my fire escape to knock over my potted succulents, I had to re-pot three of them last night after it chewed through a whole jade plant leaf. I tried leaving out a little bowl of kibble to distract it but now it just brings its tiny kitten friend around too, and last week they left muddy paw prints all over my canvas grocery tote that I hand-painted sunflowers on. I’m also still annoyed that my go-to bubble tea shop swapped their boba for those weird chewy konjac pearls without warning, they taste like weirdly sweet rubber and I wasted $7 on a taro latte that was basically undrinkable. Anyway, can you help me pick out an alcohol free, long lasting deodorant? I don’t wanna spend too much on it.
